text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to football club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameFootballClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton is a football player who plays for Nautico.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico, and Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ∧ ¬SameFootballClub(nautico, braga) ∧ FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga, and Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
∃x LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, x) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
